# Know Your Meme & TV Guide

> > A combined resource documenting internet culture and viral memes alongside television programming guides and entertainment news.

This site appears to merge Know Your Meme's comprehensive database of internet phenomena, TikTok trends, and viral content with TV Guide's television listings and streaming recommendations. The content spans meme documentation, trend explainers, and entertainment scheduling.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Catchphrases and internet slang
- Viral meme explanations
- Breaking Bad references
- Mental health memes
- Looksmaxxing culture
- Dance memes and challenges
- TV listings and streaming
- Entertainment news
- Reddit and Twitter virality
- DeviantArt and fan culture
- Millennial culture commentary
- 90s nostalgia

## TV & Streaming Guide

- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Streaming Services, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com): Homepage featuring streaming recommendations, TV reviews, and entertainment news
- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Online Videos, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV listings and channel information for shows, movies, and programs

## TikTok Trends & Viral Videos

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring art of girl lying in dirt, viral on TikTok
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' with swimming gesture
- [Millennial Burger Place | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/millennial-burger-place): TikTok trend mocking cliche millennial burger restaurant starter pack
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok as viral audio
